budget: equal unique selected episodes per matched solo/mix pair including calibration and current failure
pairing: target-conditioned; mixed model not reused across different target sides
jitter_policy: exact class x jitter counts matched
calibration: all selected training successes; score-band leave-one-out, not model-heldout CP guarantee
detector_weighting: uniform unique episode, mean loss over capped timesteps
phase_cap: ceil(mean+std) on selected success intersection of two arms
eval: all ten original noises per selected target, failure rescue and success preservation separately
initial_replay_gate: one originally failed coordinate per target must remain failure under ps_base
gpu_policy: docs/05_gpu_server_rules.md; home machine only; lease and actual ownership; one serial serve per chosen GPU
